system.description: This Merit gives the Nosferatu a cartilaginous tongue through which he feeds, believed to stem from the Larvae Nosferatu and their progeny. The tongue cannot extend more than six inches past the mouth, but it causes aggravated wounds (treat the attack as a bite). Unlike the ordinary Kiss, this feeding is very painful for the victim — much like a giant mosquito plunging a spike-sized needle into flesh and vessels, siphoning blood fast enough to collapse them.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book Two: Lepers
